validity.researcher_notes: Both articles describe the Breytovo offtake as planned or starting in 2021 and 2022. Neither says it is built or running. The sheet says operating. See the status review.

verifications.note: Wayback copy read in full. It names the Breytovo offtake pipeline and states 40 km.

fills.researcher_notes: Neftegaz, citing the Gazprom regional gas company on 4 August 2021, says the new Breytovo offtake pipeline will be 40 km long. The article reports that design work was finished, so 40 km is the design figure. The sheet length was blank.
Neither cited article states a capacity for the Breytovo offtake. No wiki citation states this value; not searched this pass.
The Neftegaz article says the project is organized by Gazprom Mezhregiongaz with Gazprom Invest as the single technical customer. It does not say who will own the pipe. The sheet owner stays.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The newest citation is from February 2022 and says construction of the Breytovo offtake is starting. No citation says the pipeline is built or carrying gas. The sheet status of operating is not supported by these pages. No change is proposed until a later source is found.
